description: Welcome to La Maison Bohème Montmartre, a historic address perched in the highest building in Paris. Once a passageway for artists such as Toulouse-Lautrec and Chaplin, this small-scale, elevator-free building has been meticulously renovated by French artisans.The Renoir apartment, spacious and air-conditioned, offers a breathtaking view of the Sacré-Cœur and combines Parisian charm with contemporary comfort — perfect for family getaways or trips with friends.The spaceThe spacious Renoir 85m2 apartment, with a view of the Sacré-Cœur, can accommodate up to 8 guests in an elegant and light-filled setting.Located on the 1st floor, this apartment features three bedrooms with queen-size beds, a large living room with a double sofa bed, a welcoming open kitchen, and three shower rooms to ensure everyone’s comfort.- Three bedrooms with queen-size beds (160x200), including one on a mezzanine- Large living room with a very comfortable double sofa bed- Two modern shower rooms with Codage toiletries- Three toilets including one separated- Fully equipped open kitchen: Nespresso machine, kettle, microwave, induction cooktop, dishwasher, toaster, washing machine- High-speed Wi-Fi, smart TV- Air conditioning in all rooms- Refined décor combining Parisian style, vintage furnishings, and artistic touches- Dedicated concierge serviceGuest accessIf you have luggage, we recommend taking a taxi, as our building is located at the top of Montmartre and is only accessible on foot via long stairways.Otherwise, the Abbesses and Anvers metro stations, as well as bus line 40, are nearby and make it easy to explore Paris.Other things to noteCheck-in: 4:00 PM | Check-out: 11:00 AMPlease check your Airbnb messages and regular messages to receive all the necessary information regarding the check-in pr
